question: Estimate the resumes uploaded per day on Naukri.com.
idealClarificationQuestions: New/updated resume uploads? Yes — fresh uploads or significant updates.
Average weekday? Yes (job activity higher on weekdays).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: India's annual job-changers + freshers using Naukri.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total Indian formal-sector job changers per year: ~25M (5M IT, 8M services, 12M retail/FMCG/BFSI/manufacturing).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Add fresh graduates entering market each year: ~10M graduates, of which ~50% use Naukri = 5M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily (~250 working days for active job search): ~70K/day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: 60-80K resume uploads per day on Naukri.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total Indian formal-sector job changers per year
Of these, use Naukri (vs LinkedIn, Foundit, direct referrals)
Add fresh graduates entering market each year
Daily (~250 working days for active job search)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 60-80K resume uploads per day on Naukri.

calculationFlow: Of these, use Naukri (vs LinkedIn, Foundit, direct referrals): ~50% = 12.5M.
Add fresh graduates entering market each year: ~10M graduates, of which ~50% use Naukri = 5M.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: 60-80K resume uploads per day on Naukri.
